authority: Canonical finite training drill/program catalog. Runtime training may select only registered drills/programs; narration and ChatGPT never create gain-bearing exercises, weights, skill targets, or attribute targets.

adaptive_priority.rule: Adaptation redistributes hours only among drills already in the resolved finite program. A skill or weapon absent from the program cannot receive gain merely because it is weak.

instructor_policy.selection: highest deterministic registered instructor quality among lawful healthy candidates at the training location or registered local training area; ties by Training then stable ref
instructor_policy.large_unit_delivery: senior exact instructor sets/corrects standard; existing 100/500/1000 command chain and ordinary qualified drill leaders deliver distributed training; no extra support or specialist manpower class
instructor_policy.instructors_continue_training: teaching duty does not cancel the instructor own deterministic program; total verified duty/training time remains bounded by ordinary elapsed-time and waking-hour rules
instructor_policy.no_free_capacity: missing local instructor/drill-leader capacity reduces verified EDU instead of being filled by narration
